channel.title: help.xinca.com — HVAC Knowledge Base Articles
channel.description: Technical articles for specifiers, engineers, and building services professionals — building controls, air-side, water-side, IAQ, and energy compliance.

item.title: Chilled-Water Pump Differential-Pressure Reset: The Complete Guide
item.description: Lady Havi explains how differential-pressure reset slashes chilled-water pump energy, with sensor placement, reset strategies and commissioning tips for VPF plants.

item.title: HVAC Industry Statistics 2026
item.description: Verified HVAC and air-conditioning statistics with every figure traced to its producing source: IEA, EIA, BLS, AHRI, EHPA, JRAIA, EPA, EMSD Hong Kong and more. Market demand, energy use, workforce and refrigerant transition data.

item.title: Chilled-Water Failure Casebook: Four Patterns, First Checks
item.description: Four verified chilled-water failures — hunting valves, backward flow limiters, bad setpoints, coil carryover — with worked numbers and the first check for each.

item.title: Air Handling Unit Coil Selection Guide
item.description: Selecting heating and cooling coils for air handling units: load calculation, coil configuration, fluid dynamics and materials for Australian climates.

item.title: VAV Damper Selection for Commercial Buildings
item.description: Selecting dampers for VAV terminal units: opposed-blade vs parallel-blade, ASHRAE sizing methods, specification pitfalls and BACnet/Modbus integration.

item.title: BMS & Building Controls: DDC to IoT
item.description: How BACnet and Modbus underpin building automation: sensor network architecture, IoT migration strategies and practical steps for upgrading legacy DDC.

item.title: Energy Efficiency in Asian Building Codes
item.description: Singapore's Green Mark 2026, Hong Kong's BEAM Plus v2.0 and Dubai's Al Sa'fat mandate submetering, continuous commissioning and 30% energy improvement.

item.title: IAQ Monitoring for Commercial Buildings
item.description: Indoor air quality monitoring has moved from nice-to-have to tenant expectation. Specifiers must require CO₂, PM2.5 and TVOC sensing with DCV integration.

item.title: Control Valve & Hydronic Balancing Guide
item.description: Globe valves vs PICV: valve authority, Cv sizing methodology, commissioning mistakes and hydronic balancing for chilled water and heating hot water.

item.title: How AI Reshapes Building Energy Management
item.description: Machine learning is transforming building energy systems: predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, demand response optimisation and HVAC control.

item.title: Data Center Energy Efficiency Guide
item.description: Practical guide to data center cooling efficiency: PUE fundamentals, rack airflow optimisation and liquid cooling adoption, backed by ASHRAE TC09.09.

item.title: Glycol Coolant Trade-Offs in Data Centres
item.description: Why data centres are now switching from ethylene glycol to food-grade propylene glycol — and how this cuts cooling from ~40% of facility power.
